objective: Use current docs-as-code, self-hosted infrastructure, and agent-orchestration evidence for a high-value global technical-writing role without inventing personal legal or compensation declarations.

source_need.title: Technical Writer
source_need.location: Remote and global, with employment outside named entities handled through Remote.com where available
requested_work: Own technical documentation for developers and enterprise users
Work through Git and GitHub with Markdown or MDX, Docusaurus, Node.js, and CI
Document cloud and self-managed software involving Java, Kubernetes, Helm, and Docker
Explain orchestration and agentic systems clearly to technical readers
source_need.boundary: The current listing and published bands show a real vacancy, not applicant eligibility, an interview, an offer, payment, or revenue. Compensation outside the named countries must not be inferred.

public_samples.role: Detailed docs-as-code operations, deployment, failure-boundary, and rollback writing
Architecture explanation for Caddy, OpenSSH, systemd, trust boundaries, and migration
Read-only MCP and provenance-oriented agent-tool documentation

supported_now: GitHub-based documentation with substantial Markdown and multilingual maintenance
Node.js and TypeScript CLI, configuration, CI, testing, release, and migration documentation
Self-hosted and cloud-edge boundaries across Caddy, OpenSSH, systemd, containers, and private services
Agent and MCP permission boundaries grounded in working public repositories
not_proven: Employment eligibility in a selected country
A salary expectation Camunda would accept
Selection, interview, offer, or customer outcome
fit.claim_boundary: The public work supports technical-writing and docs-as-code capability. It does not establish legal work status, an agreed country of employment, or Camunda-specific production experience.

material_fields_not_inferred: Work-authorization category for the intended country of employment
Exact intended work address and postcode
Salary expectation in the appropriate local currency
Consent to transfer applicant data to the United States for six months
application.policy: Do not submit the application by guessing legal status, residence, salary, or consent. The public vacancy can remain prepared until the named applicant supplies or directly confirms those declarations.
